commit.subject: LU-17000 obdclass: drop dead sscanf() error checks
commit.message:
LU-17000 obdclass: drop dead sscanf() error checks

string_to_decimal() tests sscanf() for a negative return.  The kernel's
vsscanf() only ever returns the number of conversions performed, so
those branches are dead; the "rc < 1" tests that follow them are what
actually catches a failed conversion.

Test-Parameters: trivial
Fixes: 10547cbf7ad1 ("LU-18163 obdclass: fix sysfs_memparse()/string_to_size()")
Signed-off-by: Oleg Drokin <green@whamcloud.com>
Assisted-by: ClaudeCode:Opus-5 llm_code_and_review_tools
Change-Id: Id8f952ec9deb61ce13f28e2dbbd78e2de0b4231b
